title: A government crackdown on online casinos operating in the Isle of Man has led to a major tax revenue loss, accelerating the island's slide toward a fiscal cliff (Jack Adamović Davies/Bloomberg)
summary: Jack Adamović Davies / Bloomberg: A government crackdown on online casinos operating in the Isle of Man has led to a major tax revenue loss, accelerating the island's slide toward a fiscal cliff — Online casinos were a big driver of the Isle of Man's economy. Lately, they've become a liability.
